name: zmart-option-viv-inside
why: The packages this one option needs, kept beside it rather than added to
the viewer's own list. Two of the three options being compared draw with
Viv, they are being written at the same time by different hands, and a
shared list of packages is the one file both would have had to edit at
once. Node looks for packages in the folder a file lives in before looking
further up, so a build of the harness finds these here and finds everything
else in the viewer's own installed packages, exactly as before.
Install them with:  npm --prefix viz_studio/options/viv-inside install
Viv is taken as its three separate pieces rather than as the one umbrella
package, because the umbrella also carries Viv's ready-made React viewers,
and those ask for React bindings for deck.gl that nothing here uses. This
option draws into a canvas of its own, so the layers, the readers and the
shader additions are all of Viv it wants.
